scope: Independent methodology and code review; no training or prediction loading from models.

comparator.verdict: Correct for aligned cached complete-generator predictions and frozen plant weights.
checks: read_predictions enforces exact Run No order and exact submission column order.
Baseline pooled AUC is recomputed and checked against authoritative current-winner report.
Candidate replacement changes only requested components and preserves all plant weights.
Multiple component means correspond to a fixed 50/50 blend of the complete baseline and complete replacement ensemble, not an arbitrary new global component weight.
caveats: Exported variant choice must be frozen before confirmation year if it is described as confirmation.
The comparator itself checks prediction alignment, not candidate training provenance; inspect candidate config/metrics separately.
Existing CLI is limited to 2021/2022. A 2020 baseline requires compatible historical component predictions; do not substitute in-sample outputs from models trained beyond 2020.

bootstrap.verdict: Correct exact weighted pooled AUC, with ties; correct paired complete-case temporal-block resampling for these full-year comparisons.
bootstrap.single_class_interpretation: Every full 7/14/28-day block in both validation years contains both classes; a whole-year draw retains multiple complete blocks. Thus these requested bootstrap draws cannot be single-class. Reuse on narrower slices could fail intentionally and would need an explicit invalid-draw policy, never a fabricated AUC.
limits: Circular blocks join year-end to year-start; this is a dependence sensitivity diagnostic, not proof of stationarity.
Intervals are conditional on fitted models and already-selected cached predictions.
Repeated selection of models, counts, weights, and variants on these years is not corrected.
120-200 repetitions give approximate percentile endpoints; avoid presenting them as precise significance thresholds.
Positive-draw fraction is not a p-value or a probability the candidate will improve Kaggle.

fixed_round_xgboost.verdict: Explicit null stopping disables callback-based best-round selection; eval_set remains observation only. num_boosted_rounds records actual saved rounds in both modes.
required_provenance: Freeze 2021-selected candidate parameters, selected tree count, and component replace/mean variant before looking at 2022.
Set 2022 early_stopping_rounds to null and n_estimators to the selected actual 2021 tree count.
Verify 2022 saved num_boosted_rounds equals that frozen count.
Do not choose a different count or variant after inspecting 2022 without labeling the new result additional development.
fixed_round_xgboost.minor_review_note: At review time config.get(early_stopping_rounds) made omission disable stopping. To retain a default 100, use get(early_stopping_rounds,100); explicit null still disables it. Existing configs explicitly specifying100 are unchanged.

screening_plan.verdict: Six prespecified 2021 candidates, at most two advanced unchanged into 2022 at fixed 2021-selected rounds, is a reasonable bounded development screen.
qualifications: 2021 is selection data and both years are already reused; call 2022 frozen-candidate historical confirmation, not an untouched holdout.
Existing winner includes model checkpoints selected using 2022, so fixed-round new-component confirmation does not make the whole ensemble independent of 2022.
Prefer advancing on final-ensemble micro AUC instead of standalone-model AUC alone.
Freeze which candidate and which averaging variant is primary; comparing two variants for six candidates means more than six comparisons.
A modest 2020 check adds temporal-regime evidence only if training precedes its purged boundary; it is also known reused and should be described accordingly.

final_candidate_checklist: Recompute current and candidate full-ensemble pooled micro AUC from identical cases/columns, separately for2021 and2022.
Verify candidate training case IDs exclude competition IDs, dates obey the seven-day purged boundary, and fixed-round provenance matches the selected2021 count.
Freeze complete recipe before final uncertainty comparisons; include every changed component and averaging choice.
Use paired circular blocks of7/14/28 case-start days, retaining all2352 outputs and identical draws across models; inspect sign stability and interval widths.
Report actual deltas with per-generator, transition, month and horizon checks for material regressions; compare error shares with available-pair shares.
Describe repeated-year development and remaining uncertainty explicitly; do not convert positive bootstrap fraction into probability of future improvement.

Before final export, verify all-case training uses only supplied labeled cases, original artifacts remain intact, and725-row submission has exact2353-column template ordering and finite probabilities in[0,1].
